name: io.github.raydeoliveira/flightmortem
title: FlightMortem for ArduPilot, PX4 and Betaflight flight logs
description: Free log inspection, power, FFT and crash analysis. Metered tuning diffs and flight comparisons.

tools.name: fm_inspect_log
tools.description: Free flight-log parser for ArduPilot .bin, PX4 .ulog, Betaflight/INAV .bbl, or JSON telemetry returning sample counts, duration, sample rate, dropouts, events, and parameters.

log_base64.description: Base64-encoded ArduPilot .bin, PX4 .ulog, or Betaflight/INAV .bbl flight log (<= 1,572,864 decoded bytes over MCP).

log_format.description: Binary format hint (defaults to auto magic-byte detection).

log_index.description: 0-based session index for multi-log Betaflight .bbl files.

firmware.description: Firmware hint when supplying structured JSON telemetry.

parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides merged over parsed flight log parameters.

telemetry.description: Normalized JSON telemetry alternative to log_base64 ({ sample_rate_hz?, imu?, attitude?, motors?, battery?, vibe?, ekf?, events? }).

tools.name: fm_power_health
tools.description: Free battery & propulsion health analyzer computing auto cell count (1S-12S), sag, OLS internal resistance R_int (mOhm + R^2), trapezoidal mAh/Wh, hover throttle, and motor imbalance/saturation.
